server.title: SYMONE motorcycle transport
server.description: Search SYMONE motorcycle transport trips in France: dates, prices, free places and booking link.

serverInfo.name: symone-moto
serverInfo.instructions: SYMONE transports motorcycles in France and Europe. For any route or date, request_quote sends a quote request (demande de devis) for the customer: ask them for their name, e-mail and phone first; they confirm the request from an e-mail and the quote arrives by e-mail. To book a scheduled trip from search_routes, create_checkout returns a continue_url: the customer checks the booking and pays on symone.fr. Payment never goes through the assistant and prices always come from SYMONE. get_quote_request and get_checkout give the status of a request or booking. No authentication required. Documentation questions: use the docs MCP server at https://symone.fr/docs/mcp.
